user.title: Set up BindHome
user.description: Create the BindHome infrastructure registry for this Home Assistant installation.

area_id.name: Area
area_id.description: Optional Home Assistant area containing the asset.

delete_asset.name: Delete asset
delete_asset.description: Delete an asset that has no relations or active bindings.

add_relation.name: Add relation
add_relation.description: Create a directed topology relation between two assets.

set_binding.name: Set binding
set_binding.description: Bind an asset capability and role to the Home Assistant entity that currently implements it.

remove_binding.name: Remove binding
remove_binding.description: Remove a capability binding without deleting the infrastructure asset.

get_registry.name: Get registry
get_registry.description: Return the complete BindHome registry without modifying it.

registry_recovery.title: BindHome needs Registry recovery
registry_recovery.description: BindHome could not safely load its Registry ({reason}): {message}. Normal BindHome operation remains disabled to protect stored infrastructure data. Restore a valid BindHome backup through the administrator recovery API, then reload the integration.

stale_areas.title: BindHome has elements assigned to missing Areas
stale_areas.description: {count} BindHome elements reference Home Assistant Areas that no longer exist: {assets}. Open BindHome, edit the affected elements and assign an existing room or choose no room. This Repair clears automatically when every stale Area reference is fixed.

stale_bindings.title: BindHome has connections to missing entities
stale_bindings.description: {count} BindHome connections point to Home Assistant entities that no longer exist: {bindings}. Open the affected element in BindHome and change or disconnect the connection. Temporarily unavailable hardware does not create this Repair. This Repair clears automatically when every broken connection is fixed.

common.panel_home_intro: Browse the physical elements of your home by floor and room.
common.panel_home_choose_room: Choose a room to see what is physically installed there.
common.panel_home_stale_area: Room no longer in Home Assistant

common.panel_detail_passive: This element has no smart device associated. That is a normal state for passive elements.

common.panel_add_no_matches: No element types match this search.
common.panel_add_create_error: The element could not be added. Your draft was preserved.
common.panel_delete_prepare_body: Before deleting, BindHome will calculate the relations, bindings and representation that will be affected.
common.panel_delete_impact: This will remove {relations} relations, {bindings} bindings owned by this element and {dependent} bindings from other BindHome elements.
common.panel_delete_hardware_safe: Home Assistant devices and physical entities associated with this element will not be deleted.
common.panel_delete_logical_warning: The logical Home Assistant entity {entity_id} will also disappear. Dashboards, automations or scripts outside BindHome that reference it may need to be updated.
common.panel_delete_error: The element could not be deleted. Nothing was partially removed.

common.panel_search_empty: No physical elements match this search.
common.panel_advanced_intro: Technical Registry, bulk inventory, topology, Bindings and Representations.
common.panel_shell_load_error_detail: BindHome could not load its inventory data.
common.panel_shell_refresh_error: Refresh failed. Your current work was preserved.
common.panel_shell_registry_conflict: BindHome changed in another session. Reload the latest data before trying again.
common.panel_inventory_selection_intro: Choose a Home Assistant Floor and Area before recording physical infrastructure.
common.panel_inventory_no_floor_helper: Areas without a floor remain available under No floor.
common.panel_inventory_no_areas: This floor has no Areas. Create one in Home Assistant Settings.
common.panel_inventory_quantity_intro: Set a quantity above zero to create editable drafts. Zero creates nothing.
common.panel_inventory_no_existing: No BindHome Assets are registered in this room yet.
common.panel_inventory_not_saved_yet: Drafts are not saved until the complete batch passes validation.
common.panel_inventory_no_floor_area: No Home Assistant Floors or Areas are available. Create an Area in Home Assistant Settings, then refresh BindHome.
common.panel_review_intro: Every name and type is editable. Open a row to change its optional code or capabilities.
common.panel_review_registered_helper: Read-only and not included in this batch.
common.panel_review_atomic_batch: All drafts save together as one atomic batch.
common.panel_review_save_explanation_one: {count} asset saves alone or nothing is saved.
common.panel_review_save_explanation_other: {count} assets save together or none are saved.
common.panel_review_before_save_one: {count} draft will be reviewed before saving.
common.panel_review_before_save_other: {count} drafts will be reviewed before saving.
common.panel_discard_description: Changing room clears every draft in the current batch. Nothing will be saved.
common.panel_errors_correct_field: Correct the highlighted field and save the complete batch again.
common.panel_errors_batch_fallback: The room inventory could not be saved. Nothing was saved.
common.panel_success_explanation: Only physical inventory was created. No devices or automations were created.
common.panel_infrastructure_intro: Inspect the stable Assets, topology Relations, and hardware Bindings already registered.
common.panel_infrastructure_no_assets: No infrastructure Assets are registered yet.
common.panel_browser_intro: Browse stable physical Assets by Home Assistant Floor and Area.
common.panel_browser_select_area: Choose an Area to see its registered Assets.
common.panel_browser_no_assets_home: No BindHome Assets are registered yet.
common.panel_browser_no_assets_area: No Assets are registered in this Area.
common.panel_browser_no_area_intro: Assets not assigned to a Home Assistant Area.
common.panel_browser_unknown_area_intro: These Assets reference an Area that no longer exists in Home Assistant.
common.panel_editor_identity_note: Saving preserves this Asset's stable identity. If it has a logical Representation, its original name and Home Assistant Area follow the Asset; Home Assistant custom name, entity ID and icon remain user-controlled.
common.panel_editor_save_error: The Asset could not be saved.
common.panel_editor_sync_warning: Changes were saved, but BindHome could not refresh the element.
common.panel_connection_sync_warning: Saved, but the latest connection state could not be refreshed.
common.panel_connection_showing_results: Showing {shown} of {total} results. Refine your search.
common.panel_connection_cycle_error: This connection would create a circular BindHome dependency.
common.panel_topology_showing_results: Showing {shown} of {total} results. Refine your search.
common.panel_topology_sync_warning: Saved, but the latest topology could not be refreshed.
common.panel_onboarding_welcome_body: BindHome gives the physical things in your home stable identities, while the smart devices that control or measure them can change over time.
common.panel_onboarding_replaceable_example: The Shelly, Sonoff or other Home Assistant entity connected to it today
common.panel_onboarding_model_title: Four ideas are enough to understand BindHome
common.panel_onboarding_model_body: You can start with Assets only. Bindings, topology and logical representations can be added when they are useful.
common.panel_onboarding_asset_body: A socket, light point, radiator, circuit, valve, network outlet or other part of the home.
common.panel_onboarding_capability_title: Capability — what that Asset can do
common.panel_onboarding_capability_body: For example on/off, temperature, setpoint or power measurement.
common.panel_onboarding_binding_body: A replaceable Home Assistant entity. Change the hardware later and keep the same Asset.
common.panel_onboarding_representation_body: When useful, BindHome can expose the Asset back to Home Assistant as a logical entity that automations can use.
common.panel_onboarding_structure_title: BindHome reuses Home Assistant Floors and Areas
common.panel_onboarding_structure_body: You do not maintain a second room catalogue. Create and rename Floors and Areas in Home Assistant; BindHome uses those locations for physical Assets.
common.panel_onboarding_no_areas: Create at least one Area in Home Assistant Settings, then refresh BindHome before starting the inventory.
common.panel_onboarding_structure_ready: Your Home Assistant Areas are ready to use as BindHome locations.
common.panel_onboarding_start_title: Start with one room, not with the whole house
common.panel_onboarding_start_body: Choose a room and record what is physically installed there. BindHome saves the inventory independently from whether those elements are smart today.
common.panel_onboarding_after_inventory_title: After the physical inventory, you can:
common.panel_onboarding_after_inventory_binding: Connect capabilities to the Home Assistant entities that implement them.
common.panel_onboarding_after_inventory_topolog: Describe direct infrastructure relationships such as feeds, contains or controls.
common.panel_onboarding_after_inventory_represe: Expose selected Assets as stable logical Home Assistant entities.
common.panel_import_intro: Review suggestions from existing Home Assistant Areas, Devices and Entities. Nothing is created until you confirm the complete batch.
common.panel_import_discover_error: BindHome could not discover import suggestions.
common.panel_import_review_intro: Choose create, merge or skip for every suggestion. Names, types, Areas, Capabilities and proposed Bindings remain under your control.
common.panel_import_empty: No import suggestions were found in this scope.
common.panel_import_status_help_already_bound: At least one proposed target is already bound in BindHome. Review carefully instead of creating a duplicate physical Asset.
common.panel_import_status_help_possible_asset_: BindHome found one Asset with matching display metadata. This is only a merge suggestion; physical identity remains your decision.
common.panel_import_status_help_ambiguous: Several Assets match the display metadata. Choose the physical target explicitly or skip this suggestion.
common.panel_import_atomic: Every reviewed decision is committed together or nothing is saved.
common.panel_import_commit_error: The reviewed import could not be committed.
common.panel_import_review_preserved: Your complete review has been preserved so you can correct it or rerun discovery.
common.panel_connection_replacement_load_error: Compatible replacement entities could not be loaded.
common.panel_connection_replacement_identity_pr: The Asset, topology and logical Representation keep their existing identity.
common.panel_csv_intro: Export a human-editable Asset inventory and review every change before importing it back as one transaction.
common.panel_csv_export_hint: Choose the whole Registry, one Floor or one Area. The downloaded file keeps BindHome stable Asset IDs for safe round-trip updates.
common.panel_csv_import_warning: Nothing is changed when you select a file. BindHome validates the complete CSV first and commits only after you review the preview.
common.panel_csv_import_hint: Select an edited BindHome CSV to validate it.
common.panel_csv_invalid: {count} validation problems must be fixed before import.
common.panel_csv_valid: Validation passed. Review the complete change set before committing.
common.panel_csv_conflict: The Registry changed after this preview. Validate the file again before importing.
common.panel_backup_intro: Protect BindHome's stable physical model before upgrades or major edits. Backups contain BindHome Registry data, not Home Assistant entities or device configuration.
common.panel_backup_export_hint: Download a deterministic Registry backup that can be restored later.
common.panel_backup_last: Last backup from this HA user: {date}
common.panel_backup_never: No backup has been recorded for this HA user yet.
common.panel_backup_export_error: Could not export the Registry backup.
common.panel_backup_restore_warning: Restoring replaces the complete BindHome Registry: Assets, relations, Bindings and Representations. Home Assistant entities and devices are not modified.
common.panel_backup_invalid_envelope: This file is not a BindHome Registry backup.
common.panel_backup_invalid_file: The selected backup file is invalid.
common.panel_backup_confirm_overwrite: I understand that this will replace the complete current BindHome Registry with the selected backup.
common.panel_backup_restore_saved_reload_failed: The valid Registry was restored to storage, but Home Assistant could not reload BindHome automatically. Check Repairs and reload the integration.
common.panel_backup_restore_error: Could not restore the Registry backup.
common.panel_backup_conflict: The Registry changed since this page was loaded. Refresh before restoring.
common.panel_backup_recovery_required: BindHome is in Registry recovery mode. A valid backup can be restored even though the normal Registry manager is not loaded.
